name: create_backup
description: Creates a system backup on the MikroTik device.

name: list_backups
description: Lists backup files on the MikroTik device.

name: create_export
description: Creates a configuration export file (rsc/json/xml) on the MikroTik device.

name: export_section
description:
Exports a specific RouterOS configuration section to a file.

Notes:
    section: RouterOS path without leading slash e.g. "ip address", "interface vlan",
        "ip firewall filter", "ip firewall nat", "queue simple"

name: download_file
description: Downloads a backup or export file from the MikroTik device as base64-encoded content.

name: upload_file
description: Uploads a base64-encoded file to the MikroTik device (for restore operations).

name: restore_backup
description: Restores a system backup on the MikroTik device; triggers a reboot.

name: import_configuration
description: Imports and executes a RouterOS configuration script (.rsc file) on the device.

name: remove_file
description: Removes a file from the MikroTik device filesystem.

name: backup_info
description: Gets detailed information about a backup file on the MikroTik device.

name: create_dhcp_server
description:
Creates a DHCP server bound to the specified interface on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    lease_time: duration e.g. "1d", "12h", "30m", "1h30m"

name: list_dhcp_servers
description: Lists DHCP servers on the MikroTik device.

name: get_dhcp_server
description: Gets detailed information about a specific DHCP server.

name: create_dhcp_network
description: Creates a DHCP network configuration (gateway, DNS, domain, etc.) on the MikroTik device.

name: create_dhcp_pool
description:
Creates a DHCP address pool with the given IP ranges on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    ranges: hyphen-separated range(s) e.g. "192.168.1.1-192.168.1.100"
        Multiple ranges comma-separated: "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50,10.0.0.100-10.0.0.120"

name: remove_dhcp_server
description: Removes a DHCP server from the MikroTik device.

name: set_dns_servers
description: Sets DNS server configuration.

name: get_dns_settings
description: Gets current DNS configuration.

name: add_dns_static
description: Adds a static DNS entry.

name: list_dns_static
description: Lists static DNS entries.

name: get_dns_static
description: Gets details of a specific static DNS entry.

name: update_dns_static
description: Updates a static DNS entry.

name: remove_dns_static
description: Removes a static DNS entry.

name: enable_dns_static
description: Enables a static DNS entry.

name: disable_dns_static
description: Disables a static DNS entry.

name: get_dns_cache
description: Gets the current DNS cache.

name: flush_dns_cache
description: Flushes the DNS cache.

name: get_dns_cache_statistics
description: Gets DNS cache statistics.

name: add_dns_regexp
description: Adds a DNS regexp entry.

name: test_dns_query
description: Tests a DNS query.

name: export_dns_config
description: Exports DNS configuration to a file.

name: create_filter_rule
description:
Creates a firewall filter rule in the specified chain on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    connection_state: comma-separated e.g. "established,related,new,invalid"
    limit: RouterOS rate/burst string e.g. "10,5:packet" or "10/1s:packet"
    tcp_flags: RouterOS flag expression e.g. "syn,!ack"
    place_before: rule number or ID (*N) to insert before e.g. "0" or "*3"

name: list_filter_rules
description: Lists firewall filter rules on the MikroTik device.

name: get_filter_rule
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific firewall filter rule.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"

name: update_filter_rule
description:
Updates an existing firewall filter rule on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"
    connection_state: comma-separated e.g. "established,related"
    limit: RouterOS rate string e.g. "10,5:packet"
    tcp_flags: RouterOS flag expression e.g. "syn,!ack"
    Pass "" to clear an optional field (e.g. src_address="").

name: remove_filter_rule
description:
Removes a firewall filter rule from the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"

name: move_filter_rule
description:
Moves a firewall filter rule to a different position in the chain.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"
    destination: 0-based target position index

name: enable_filter_rule
description: Enables a firewall filter rule.

name: disable_filter_rule
description: Disables a firewall filter rule.

name: create_basic_firewall_setup
description: Creates a basic firewall setup with common security rules on the MikroTik device.

name: create_nat_rule
description:
Creates a NAT rule (srcnat or dstnat) on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    to_addresses: single IP or range e.g. "10.0.0.1" or "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.10"
    to_ports: single port or range e.g. "8080" or "8080-8090"
    place_before: rule number or ID (*N) to insert before e.g. "0" or "*3"

name: list_nat_rules
description: Lists NAT rules on the MikroTik device.

name: get_nat_rule
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific NAT rule.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"

name: update_nat_rule
description:
Updates an existing NAT rule on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"
    to_addresses: single IP or range e.g. "10.0.0.1" or "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.10"
    to_ports: single port or range e.g. "8080" or "8080-8090"
    Pass "" to clear an optional field.

name: remove_nat_rule
description:
Removes a NAT rule from the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"

name: move_nat_rule
description:
Moves a NAT rule to a different position in the chain.

Notes:
    rule_id: use the ID from list output e.g. "*1" or "0"
    destination: 0-based target position index

name: enable_nat_rule
description: Enables a NAT rule.

name: disable_nat_rule
description: Disables a NAT rule.

name: list_interfaces
description:
Lists all interfaces on the MikroTik device (ethernet, bridge, WireGuard,
PPPoE, VLAN, WiFi, SFP, LTE, loopback, and any other type).

Notes:
    type_filter: RouterOS interface type e.g. "ether", "bridge", "vlan",
        "wg", "pppoe-out", "wifi", "lte", "loopback"
    name_filter: partial name match e.g. "ether" matches ether1, ether2 …

name: get_interface
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific interface by name.

Notes:
    name: exact interface name e.g. "ether1", "bridge", "pppoe-out1", "wg0"

name: enable_interface
description:
Enables an interface on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    name: exact interface name e.g. "ether1", "bridge", "pppoe-out1"

name: disable_interface
description:
Disables an interface on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    name: exact interface name e.g. "ether1", "bridge", "pppoe-out1"

name: add_ip_address
description: Adds an IP address to an interface on the MikroTik device.

name: list_ip_addresses
description: Lists IP addresses on the MikroTik device.

name: get_ip_address
description: Gets detailed information about a specific IP address by ID or address value.

name: remove_ip_address
description: Removes an IP address from the MikroTik device by ID or address value.

name: create_ip_pool
description:
Creates an IP pool with the given address ranges on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    ranges: hyphen-separated range(s) e.g. "192.168.1.1-192.168.1.100"
        Multiple ranges comma-separated: "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50,10.0.0.100-10.0.0.120"

name: list_ip_pools
description: Lists IP pools on the MikroTik device.

name: get_ip_pool
description: Gets detailed information about a specific IP pool including used address count.

name: update_ip_pool
description:
Updates an existing IP pool's name, ranges, or next-pool reference.

Notes:
    ranges: hyphen-separated range(s) e.g. "192.168.1.1-192.168.1.100"
        Multiple ranges comma-separated: "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50,10.0.0.100-10.0.0.120"
    Pass "" for next_pool to clear it.

name: remove_ip_pool
description: Removes an IP pool from the MikroTik device (fails if pool is in use).

name: list_ip_pool_used
description: Lists currently used (allocated) addresses from IP pools.

name: expand_ip_pool
description:
Expands an existing IP pool by appending additional address ranges.

Notes:
    additional_ranges: hyphen-separated range(s) e.g. "192.168.1.101-192.168.1.150"
        Multiple ranges comma-separated: "10.0.0.51-10.0.0.60,10.0.0.70-10.0.0.80"

name: get_logs
description: Gets logs from the MikroTik device with optional topic, time, and message filters.

name: get_logs_by_severity
description: Gets logs filtered by severity level (debug/info/warning/error/critical).

name: get_logs_by_topic
description: Gets logs for a specific topic/facility (system, dhcp, interface, firewall, etc.).

name: search_logs
description: Searches log messages for a specific term.

name: get_system_events
description: Gets system-related log events (login, reboot, config-change, etc.).

name: get_security_logs
description: Gets security-related log entries (login failures, blocked connections, etc.).

name: clear_logs
description: Clears all logs from the MikroTik device. This action cannot be undone.

name: get_log_statistics
description: Gets log entry counts by topic and severity from the MikroTik device.

name: export_logs
description: Exports logs to a file on the MikroTik device with optional topic and time filters.

name: monitor_logs
description: Monitors MikroTik logs in near-real-time for a limited duration (max 60s).

name: create_queue_type
description:
Creates a queue type (qdisc). kind selects the discipline (cake, fq-codel, sfq, red, pcq, pfifo, bfifo); remaining params are per-discipline options.

Notes:
    pcq_rate: bandwidth per flow e.g. "1M", "512k"
    pcq_classifier: comma-separated classifiers e.g. "src-address,dst-address"
    cake_rtt: round-trip time e.g. "50ms", "100ms"
    fq_codel_target / fq_codel_interval: time e.g. "5ms", "100ms"

name: list_queue_types
description: Lists queue types on the MikroTik device.

name: get_queue_type
description: Gets detailed information about a specific queue type.

name: update_queue_type
description: Updates an existing queue type's discipline-specific settings.

name: remove_queue_type
description: Removes a queue type from the MikroTik device.

name: create_queue_tree
description:
Creates a hierarchical queue tree entry attached to a parent interface or queue.

Notes:
    max_limit / limit_at / burst_limit / burst_threshold: bandwidth e.g. "10M", "512k", "1G"
    burst_time: duration e.g. "8s"
    parent: interface name e.g. "ether1" or parent queue name
    priority: 1 (highest) – 8 (lowest)

name: list_queue_trees
description: Lists queue trees on the MikroTik device.

name: get_queue_tree
description: Gets detailed information about a specific queue tree.

name: update_queue_tree
description:
Updates an existing queue tree entry (bandwidth limits, parent, priority, etc.).

Notes:
    max_limit / limit_at / burst_limit / burst_threshold: bandwidth e.g. "10M", "512k"
    burst_time: duration e.g. "8s"
    priority: 1 (highest) – 8 (lowest)

name: remove_queue_tree
description: Removes a queue tree from the MikroTik device.

name: enable_queue_tree
description: Enables a queue tree.

name: disable_queue_tree
description: Disables a queue tree.

name: create_simple_queue
description:
Creates a simple queue to rate-limit a target address or interface.

Notes:
    target: IP/CIDR or interface e.g. "192.168.1.0/24" or "ether1"
    max_limit / limit_at / burst_limit / burst_threshold: upload/download bandwidth
        as "UL/DL" e.g. "10M/10M", or single value e.g. "10M"
    burst_time: duration e.g. "8s"
    priority: 1 (highest) – 8 (lowest)

name: list_simple_queues
description: Lists simple queues on the MikroTik device.

name: get_simple_queue
description: Gets detailed information about a specific simple queue.

name: update_simple_queue
description:
Updates an existing simple queue's rate limits, target, or scheduling settings.

Notes:
    target: IP/CIDR or interface e.g. "192.168.1.0/24" or "ether1"
    max_limit / limit_at / burst_limit / burst_threshold: upload/download bandwidth
        as "UL/DL" e.g. "10M/10M", or single value e.g. "10M"
    burst_time: duration e.g. "8s"
    priority: 1 (highest) – 8 (lowest)

name: remove_simple_queue
description: Removes a simple queue from the MikroTik device.

name: enable_simple_queue
description: Enables a simple queue.

name: disable_simple_queue
description: Disables a simple queue.

name: safe_mode_status
description: Returns whether MikroTik Safe Mode is currently active.

name: enable_safe_mode
description: Activates MikroTik Safe Mode; changes are held in memory and auto-reverted on disconnect until committed.

name: commit_safe_mode
description: Commits all pending Safe Mode changes to persistent storage and exits Safe Mode.

name: rollback_safe_mode
description: Discards all pending Safe Mode changes by closing the SSH session, triggering automatic rollback.

name: add_route
description:
Adds a route to the routing table.

Notes:
    dst_address: CIDR e.g. "0.0.0.0/0", "192.168.1.0/24"
    check_gateway: "ping" or "arp"
    distance: 1-255 (lower = higher priority)

name: list_routes
description: Lists routes in MikroTik routing table.

name: get_route
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific route.

Notes:
    route_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*3"

name: update_route
description:
Updates a route.

Notes:
    route_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*3"
    dst_address: CIDR e.g. "192.168.1.0/24"
    check_gateway: "ping" or "arp"
    distance: 1-255
    Pass "" to routing_mark, vrf_interface, or pref_src to clear them.

name: remove_route
description:
Removes a route.

Notes:
    route_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*3"

name: enable_route
description:
Enables a route.

Notes:
    route_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*3"

name: disable_route
description:
Disables a route.

Notes:
    route_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*3"

name: get_routing_table
description: Gets a specific routing table.

name: check_route_path
description: Checks the route path to a destination.

name: get_route_cache
description: Gets the route cache.

name: flush_route_cache
description: Flushes the route cache.

name: add_default_route
description: Adds a default route.

name: add_blackhole_route
description:
Adds a blackhole route.

Notes:
    dst_address: CIDR e.g. "10.0.0.0/8"
    distance: 1-255

name: get_route_statistics
description: Gets routing table statistics.

name: add_user
description: Adds a user to MikroTik device.

name: list_users
description: Lists users on MikroTik device.

name: get_user
description: Gets detailed information about a specific user.

name: update_user
description: Updates a user.

name: remove_user
description: Removes a user.

name: disable_user
description: Disables a user.

name: enable_user
description: Enables a user.

name: add_user_group
description: Adds a user group.

name: list_user_groups

name: get_user_group
description: Gets detailed information about a specific user group.

name: update_user_group
description: Updates a user group.

name: remove_user_group
description: Removes a user group.

name: get_active_users
description: Gets currently active/logged-in users.

name: disconnect_user
description: Disconnects an active user session.

name: export_user_config
description: Exports user configuration to a file.

name: set_user_ssh_keys
description: Sets SSH keys for a specific user.

name: list_user_ssh_keys
description: Lists SSH keys for a specific user.

name: remove_user_ssh_key
description: Removes an SSH key.

name: create_vlan_interface
description: Creates a VLAN interface on the MikroTik device with the given VLAN ID and parent interface.

name: list_vlan_interfaces

name: get_vlan_interface

name: update_vlan_interface
description: Updates an existing VLAN interface's settings on the MikroTik device.

name: remove_vlan_interface

name: create_wireless_interface
description: Creates a wireless interface on the MikroTik device (auto-detects RouterOS v6/v7 syntax).

name: list_wireless_interfaces
description: Lists wireless interfaces on the MikroTik device.

name: get_wireless_interface
description: Gets detailed information about a specific wireless interface.

name: remove_wireless_interface
description: Removes a wireless interface from the MikroTik device.

name: enable_wireless_interface
description: Enables a wireless interface.

name: disable_wireless_interface
description: Disables a wireless interface.

name: scan_wireless_networks
description: Scans for nearby wireless networks using the specified interface.

name: get_wireless_registration_table
description: Gets the wireless registration table (connected clients) from the MikroTik device.

name: check_wireless_support
description: Checks if the device supports wireless and reports the RouterOS version and wireless interface type.

name: list_wireless_security_profiles

description: Legacy function - not supported in RouterOS v7.x

description: Legacy function - different in RouterOS v7.x

name: list_wireless_access_list
description: Legacy function - different in RouterOS v7.x

description: Legacy function - different in RouterOS v7.x

name: update_wireless_interface
description: Updates an existing wireless interface's settings (name, SSID, enabled state, etc.).

name: create_wireguard_interface
description: Creates a WireGuard interface on the MikroTik device.

name: list_wireguard_interfaces
description: Lists WireGuard interfaces on the MikroTik device.

name: get_wireguard_interface
description: Gets detailed information about a specific WireGuard interface.

name: update_wireguard_interface
description: Updates an existing WireGuard interface's settings on the MikroTik device.

name: remove_wireguard_interface
description: Removes a WireGuard interface from the MikroTik device.

name: enable_wireguard_interface
description: Enables a WireGuard interface.

name: disable_wireguard_interface
description: Disables a WireGuard interface.

name: add_wireguard_peer
description:
Adds a WireGuard peer (with public key and allowed addresses) to an interface on the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    allowed_address: CIDR, comma-separated for multiple e.g. "10.0.0.2/32" or "10.0.0.0/24,192.168.0.0/24"
    endpoint_address: remote host IP or hostname e.g. "203.0.113.1"
    persistent_keepalive: seconds as string e.g. "25"

name: list_wireguard_peers
description: Lists WireGuard peers on the MikroTik device.

name: get_wireguard_peer
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific WireGuard peer by ID.

Notes:
    peer_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*2"

name: update_wireguard_peer
description:
Updates an existing WireGuard peer's allowed addresses, endpoint, keepalive, or enabled state.

Notes:
    peer_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*2"
    allowed_address: CIDR, comma-separated e.g. "10.0.0.2/32" or "10.0.0.0/24,192.168.0.0/24"
    persistent_keepalive: seconds as string e.g. "25"
    Pass "" for endpoint_address or preshared_key to clear them.

name: remove_wireguard_peer
description:
Removes a WireGuard peer from the MikroTik device.

Notes:
    peer_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*2"

name: enable_wireguard_peer
description:
Enables a WireGuard peer.

Notes:
    peer_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*2"

name: disable_wireguard_peer
description:
Disables a WireGuard peer.

Notes:
    peer_id: "*N" or "N" from list output e.g. "*2"

name: generate_wireguard_client_config
description: Generates a wg0.conf client config string from the given keys and server endpoint. Does not communicate with the router.
